## 2. Legal fraternity united against plan to extend top judges’ tenure.

Bar leaders warned that changing the retirement age of superior‑court judges risks eroding confidence in the bench and upsetting career progression in the lower judiciary. Magistrates and district judges <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">voted unanimously</span> to oppose the move, while the cabinet spokesman said <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">no final decision</span> had been reached and more information had been sought.

Multiple regional bar associations echoed those concerns and questioned the timing of any tenure change.

## 3. Government launched Rs. 51bn scheme to bring safe water to 67,000 households in the North Central dry zone.

The utility said the project will build a treatment plant and lay <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">more than 1,500 kilometres</span> of distribution lines to serve areas long affected by <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">chronic kidney disease</span>. ## 4. Dengue cases topped 71,000 with Western Province hardest hit.

## 10. Cabinet cleared a $35m loan and grants for grid‑linked rooftop solar and virtual net metering.
